notes: Summary: Fortalan is a mid-sized defense integrator running classified and unclassified contact centers for several federal agencies. Looking for on-prem/air-gapped agent assist + ticket summarization that never touches public cloud.
Primary ask: agent assist with tool-calling (CRM actions, ticket edit, case tagging) + high-quality ticket summarization for long voice transcripts; mandatory offline deployment; HSM-backed keys.

Latency/throughput targets: sub-second median agent assist response (target 150-300ms), 95th <= 500ms; spike tolerance to 1.5-2k concurrent agents during incidents; batching allowed but must not break interactive latency.

Model preferences: open model family acceptable if quantized & validated for safety; prefer model variants that support KV cache and fast attention kernels; need control-plane that can be isolated in customer datacenter.
Security: strict data residency, full audit log with 7-year retention, SSO/SAML, FIPS-140 KMS, ability to run in disconnected networks; evidence required for SOC2/ISO27001 adherence for vendors.
Quote from CISO: "No inference traffic can egress our network — model bundle must be delivered as an air-gapped package. We need reproducible attestation of binary provenance."

POC plan: 6-week POC inside Fortalan SOC lab. Week 1: delivery of sanitized model bundle + offline console. Week 2-3: integration with in-house ACD/VOIP and CRM (internal connector). Week 4: synthetic spike and chaos testing. Week 5: security red team review. Week 6: acceptance & runbook handoff.

Tech constraints: existing telephony uses Cisco UCCE; connector must run on approved jumpbox with limited ports; ASR pipeline runs on-prem (Kaldi/NeMo) and outputs must be accepted by Redwood runtime. Redaction must happen pre-indexing.

Redwood asks: full architecture diagram for on-prem control plane; HSM/KMS integration spec; signed SBOM for runtime binaries; fallback policy to smaller quantized models when memory pressure observed.

Acceptance criteria: PII redaction verified, audit logs accessible to Fortalan SecOps, median latency <= 300ms under 1000 concurrent agents, successful offline deploy without internet, security sign-off from Fortalan CISO.
Commercial notes: procurement prefers annual committed Dedicated or Enterprise Private license; budget range provided $500k-$1M ARR; legal needs standard FedRAMP-adjacent clauses — negotiating OK.
Next meeting: technical deep-dive with Fortalan integrators + Redwood infra team scheduled 2026-03-22; action items include offline model packaging checklist and test harness for synthetic spikes.

Stability concern flagged by Fortalan platform team: during heavy incident simulations they require 99.9% availability of routing/agent assist; want graceful degradation to text-only summary when GPU pool saturated.
